21649.note: This is a geometry diagnostic only. The carbohydrate OCR text '269' is not interpreted as 26 g; the existing canonical nutrition for this product continues to come only from the independently corroborated production rescue.

validated_safety_properties: The explicit 100 g/100 ml basis header must be unique; missing or multiple headers fail closed.
Visual rows are associated by center geometry rather than bounding-box overlap so tall OCR boxes cannot bridge multiple table rows.
Core row labels are matched immediately to the left of a candidate cell with a narrow exact-label vocabulary; unrelated ingredient text is not used as a nutrition row label.
More than one geometrically plausible cell on a labeled row is rejected as AMBIGUOUS_NUMERIC_COLUMN.
No nutrition value is parsed, inferred, ranked, selected for usability, or submitted to canonical reconciliation by this pilot.
next_safe_step: Use the validated geometry only as an additional diagnostic gate on a bounded sample of ambiguous multi-column REVIEW products. Before any production use, add a separate exact numeric cell parser with tests for kJ/kcal pairs, decimal punctuation and unit adjacency, then require independent OCR-family corroboration and the existing energy/macro coherence barriers.
